mapper.sql: id, user_id, month, total_income, total_expense, savings_rate, net_worth_start, net_worth_end, subscription_spend, detail, created_at, updated_at

CASE WHEN a.type = 'liability' THEN -ABS(COALESCE(a.initial_balance, 0)) ELSE COALESCE(a.initial_balance, 0) END + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.debit) - SUM(e.credit) FROM entry e INNER JOIN `transaction` t ON t.id = e.transaction_id AND t.is_deleted = 0 WHERE e.account_id = a.id AND e.account_type = 'account' AND e.is_deleted = 0 AND t.date <= #{asOfDate}), 0) AS current_balance
mapper.select: SELECT FROM monthly_report WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND month >= #{fromMonth} ORDER BY month DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO monthly_report ( user_id, month, total_income, total_expense, savings_rate, net_worth_start, net_worth_end, subscription_spend, detail, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{month}, #{totalIncome}, #{totalExpense}, #{savingsRate}, #{netWorthStart}, #{netWorthEnd}, #{subscriptionSpend}, #{detail}, NOW() )
mapper.select:
SELECT a.id, a.user_id, a.name, a.type, a.icon, a.color, a.initial_balance, a.credit_limit, a.bill_day, a.repayment_day, a.include_in_net_worth, a.allow_transfer, a.enable_alert, a.alert_threshold, a.sort_order, a.`desc`, a.is_deleted, a.created_at, a.updated_at,
FROM account a WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY a.id

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) FROM `transaction` t WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.is_deleted = 0 AND t.transaction_type = 'expense' AND t.source_template_id IS NOT NULL AND t.date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
SELECT DISTINCT t.user_id FROM `transaction` t WHERE t.is_deleted = 0 AND DATE_FORMAT(t.date, '%Y-%m') = #{month}
